name: open-wearables-infra
description: SST infrastructure for Open Wearables (Sense Loop deployment)

scripts.deploy:pre-pilot: npm run check-secrets:staging && PRE_PILOT=true sst deploy --stage staging
scripts.deploy:pre-pilot:with-frontend: npm run check-secrets:staging && PRE_PILOT=true DEPLOY_FRONTEND=true sst deploy --stage staging
scripts.deploy:pilot: npm run check-secrets:staging && sst deploy --stage staging
scripts.deploy:pilot:with-frontend: npm run check-secrets:staging && DEPLOY_FRONTEND=true sst deploy --stage staging
scripts.deploy:staging: npm run check-secrets:staging && sst deploy --stage staging
scripts.deploy:staging:with-frontend: npm run check-secrets:staging && DEPLOY_FRONTEND=true sst deploy --stage staging
scripts.deploy:production: npm run check-secrets:production && sst deploy --stage production
scripts.deploy:production:with-frontend: npm run check-secrets:production && DEPLOY_FRONTEND=true sst deploy --stage production
